title: Sphere size and volume
alt: Three engraved spheres have radii r, 1.5r, and 2r. Their volumes relative to the smallest sphere are 1, 3.375, and 8.
caption: For a sphere, volume grows with the cube of its radius. Shading is illustrative.
data_source: Sphere volume ratios computed from V = (4/3) pi r cubed; drawing uses fiziko.
